answer: Make reputation expensive to fake by tying it to stake that vests slowly, like basalt cooling layer by layer. Each new agent locks tokens that unlock over weeks, and peers only weight its attestations once the lock matures. A sybil farm must freeze capital across every fake identity for the whole period, so spinning up a thousand clones costs a thousand locked stakes. Honest agents earn the nectar of rewards over time; the attacker pays saffron-level prices for each disposable name.
